t: Din chametzo shel nokri shehupqad etzel yisrael
s: Din chametzo shel nokri shehupqad etzel yisrael ubo y"z seipim: katub battora "lo yeraeh leka chametz", yakol im taman oto bebor ad sheeno nireh, o shehipqid oto beyad nokri, lo yihyeh ober alayv, shehare eno nireh lo kol yeme happesach, talmud lomar "shibat yamim seor lo yimmatze bebattekem", apillu hitmino o hipqido ben beyad nokri ben beyad yisrael. Apillu im hannipqad qibbel alayv acharayut sheim yigganeb o yobad mimmennu yitchayyeb leshallem lo deme chametzo, venimtza shehannipqad ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" kemo sheyyitbaer, ap al pi ken ober alayv gam hammapqid be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", kevan sheggup hechametz hu shello, veap al pi shenneemar "lo yimmatze bebattekem", vechametz zeh eno bebeto, mikkol maqom kevan shehannipqad qibbel happiqqadon middato venoten lo reshut lehannicho betok beto, hare hishil lehammapqid et hammaqom shehechametz munnach alayv, vahare maqom zeh qanuy lehammapqid, lepikak ober hu al hechametz hammunnach sham keillu haya munnach bebeto shehu dar bo, shehare omra tora "lo yeraeh leka seor bekol gebuleka", kol maqom shehu gebulo, ap al pi sheeno beto shehu dar bo. Abal mi shehitmin chametzo bachatzero shel chabero shello middato, shello hishil lo chabero maqom bachatzero lehanniach sham chametzo — eno ober alayv min hattora, kevan sheeno munnach lo bebeto velo birshuto shel baal hechametz. Umikkol maqom, middibre soperim chayyab lebaaro o lemokro leeno yehudi beereb pesach qodem shaa shishshit, kevan sheggup hechametz hu shello ella sheeno munnach birshuto. Veim lo mekaro ad shehiggia shaa shishshit — chayyab lebaaro min haolam legamre, vekol rega verega sheeno mebaaro hu ober alayv be"bal yimmatze" middibre soperim. Veim abar alayv happesach velo biaro — hare chametz zeh asur baakila ubahanaa lekol adam miyyisrael, kedin chametz sheabar alayv happesach bebet yisrael:

Hoil vehaadam ober al chametzo ap al pi shehu mupqad beyad acherim o shehu tamun sheeno nireh lo, im ken lamma omra tora "lo yeraeh leka", lomar leka sheap hechametz hannireh leka vehu matzuy bebeteka, ap al pi ken en atta ober alayv ella im ken ani qore bo "leka", kelomar shehu shelleka, perat lachametzo shel nokri hammupqad beyad hayyisrael. Apillu hu immo bebeto shehu dar bo bepesach — hare zeh muttar, mippene sheeno shello. Vaapillu hechametz hu shel ger toshab sheyyad hayyisrael sholetet alayv veal nekasayv, vaapillu hu sharuy bachatzero shel yisrael vehu vekol asher lo kabush tachat yad yisrael, ap al pi ken kol zeman sheen shem hayyisrael niqra al zeh hechametz — en tzarik lebaaro:

Umikkol maqom, middibre soperim nokri shehebi chametzo leyisrael betok happesach kede lehapqido etzlo — lo yeqabbel mimmennu hayyisrael, ap al pi sheeno nogea behechametz beyado ella hu omer lehannokri: "hinneh habbayit lepaneka hannach bemaqom shettirtzeh" — ap al pi ken asur, gezera shemma yishkach veyokal mimmennu, sheen hannokri meshammer chametzo shello yokal mimmennu hayyisrael, kevan shekkebar hipqido etzlo hare samak al neemanuto. Abal im hannokri eno mapqid etzlo hechametz — muttar lo lehannicho sheyyikkanes lebeto vachametzo immo. Veap al pi shehayyisrael roeh oto — en bekak kelum, shehare neemar "leka" — shelleka i atta roeh, abal atta roeh shel acherim. Umikkol maqom, im nokri zeh hu abdo o poalo shemmezonotayv alayv — en lehannicho sheyyikkanes labbayit leekol chametz, ap al pi shehechametz hu shel hannokri, mikkol maqom yesh lachosh lemarit haayin sheyyachshedu oto shehu maakil et abdo chametz bepesach. Abal nokri acher sheen mezonotayv alayv — muttar lehannicho liknos labbayit leekol mechametzo. Abal asur lehannicho sheyyokal mechametzo al hashshulchan beshaa sheyyisrael okel al zeh hashshulchan, apillu im zeh hayyisrael en lo shum hekkerut im zeh hannokri, sheen lachosh shemma yaakilennu hannokri mechametzo, mikkol maqom kevan shechametz bepesach bemashshehu, rachoq haddabar shello yitareb perur echad shel hannokri beshel yisrael. Vaapillu im hayyisrael hu okel al mappa meyuchedet, ap al pi ken yesh lehachamir shello yokal al hashshulchan shehannokri okel alayv chametzo, mishshum "lek lek amrinan linzira, sechor sechor, lekarma lo tiqrab":

Abal muttar lehannicho leekol chametzo al hashshulchan beshaa sheen yisrael okel alayv, raq sheyyizzaher hayyisrael lenaqqot hashshulchan yapeh achar akilat hannokri, shello yishshaaru sham perurin mechametzo. Veken tzarik lizzaher kesheyyelek hannokri mibbeto sheyyittol kol chametzo immo, velo yishtayyer mimmennu meuma bebet hayyisrael, gezera shemma yishkach veyoklennu, kevan shehu ragil bechametz kol hashshana — yesh bo lachosh leshikcha yoter mishsheanu chosheshim bishar issure tora, sheadam bodel atzmo mehem veeno shokeach issuro kevan sheeno ragil bahem. Abal kol zeman shehannokri babbayit — en lachosh shemma yistappeq hayyisrael mechametzo, shehare hannokri hu meshammero beatzmo:

Veim halak mishsham hannokri vehinniach chametzo munnach bebet yisrael shello middato, veen hayyisrael rotzeh lehitgarot im hannokri lehashlik chametzo min beto lirshut harabbim — tzarik sheyyaaseh lepanayv mechitztza gaboah y' tepachim, kede sheyyihyeh lo hekker velo yishkach al issur chametz velo yabo lehistappeq mimmennu. Vetzarik shettehe hamchitztza asuya middabar qabua shechosemet hi haoberim sham, abal lo missadin vekayyotze bo, kevan sheyyekolin lelek velabo tachat hassadin — yesh lachosh shemma yabou lehistappeq min hechametz hammunnach sham. Veim hu shabbat o yom tob shei epshar laasot mechitztza middabar qabua — yikpeh alayv et hakkeli ad haereb, kede sheyyihyeh mekusseh min haayin velo yabou leekol mimmennu, velaereb miyyad yaaseh lepanayv mechitztza kehilkatah, velo yismok al kepiyyat hakkeli, gezera shemma yinnatel hakkeli letzorek tashmisho veyitgalleh hechametz veyishkach veyoklennu:

Veim haddabar barur veyadua shello yishtaheh hannokri chutz lebeto shel hayyisrael shechametzo munnach betoko raq kachatzi hayyom veachar kak yachazor lebet hayyisrael littol chametzo mishsham — en tzarik laasot lepanayv mechitztza, apillu hu chullo shel moed shemmuttar baasiyyat melaka (sheenah maaseh umman, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"m), ella day lo bikpiyyat keli ad sheyyabo hannokri veyittol chametzo, dekevan shello yishtaheh hannokri raq kachatzi hayyom — en chosheshin shemma yinnatel hakkeli bachatzi yom zeh:

Vekol zeh keshekkebar halak lo hannokri venishar chametzo munnach bebet hayyisrael shello middaat hayyisrael, abal lekattechilla lo yannichennu hayyisrael lelek mibbeto ella im ken yittol chametzo immo, apillu lo yishtaheh sham chutz lebeto raq shaa achat, vaapillu rotzeh laasot lepanayv mechitztza kehilkatah:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Betok happesach, o beereb pesach mishshaa shishshit ulemala, abal qodem shaa shishshit muttar leqabbel piqdonot chametz min hannokri, ap al pi sheyyihyeh happiqqadon bebeto kol yeme happesach — en bekak kelum, raq sheyyaaseh lepanayv mechitztza kehilkatah, kemo shennitbaer:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen acharayut happiqqadon al yisrael miggeneba vaabeda beones, dehaynu sheim yishmerennu hayyisrael kederek hashshomerim veachar kak yigganeb o yobad mimmennu, lo yitchayyeb hayyisrael leshallem lo middin tora, velo middin hammelek vechuqqayv al ammo, kegon sheqqibbel mimmennu happiqqadon bistam, velo amar lo hayyisrael sheyyitchayyeb leshallem lo im yigganeb o yobad mimmennu beones. Abal im acharayut happiqqadon al hayyisrael, sheim yigganeb o yobad mimmennu beones yitchayyeb leshallem lo middin tora, ap al pi shello pasha bishmirato, kegon sheamar lo hayyisrael: "im yigganeb o yobad mimmenni ashallem leka", veqana mimmennu hannokri beqinyan sudar shello yachazor bo, o apillu lo qana mimmennu ella sheddin hammelek hu sheyyeshallem lo, kevan sheamar lo ken beperush bishat happiqqadon veal semak zeh hipqido etzlo — hare piqqadon zeh nechshab lehayyisrael leinyan biur chametz keillu hu shello mammash, kevan shehu chayyab beacharayuto, vechayyab lebaaro beereb pesach min hattora. Veim lo biaro — ober alayv belo taaseh, shenneemar "lo yimmatze bebattekem", velo neemar "lo yimmatze lakem bebattekem", perat leshel acherim, ella al korchak ap beshel acherim ober alayv im hu mupqad etzlo. Vei epshar lomar ap keshello qibbel alayv acharayut yaabor alayv, shehare kebar neemar "lo yeraeh leka" — shelleka i atta roeh, abal atta roeh shel acherim, ha en hakkatub medabber ella kesheqqibbel alayv acharayut, kevan sheillu haya nignab o neebad chal hahepsed al hayyisrael — hare hu keshello mammash leinyan biur chametz bilbad miggezerat hakkatub:

Abal im lo qibbel alayv hayyisrael acharayut geneba vaabeda beones, *[ap al pi sheqqibbel alayv leshomro shemira meulla kederek hashshomerim, veim yipsha bishmirato velo yishmerennu kederek hashshomerim yitchayyeb leshallem lo — en zeh niqra qabbalat acharayut lihyot happiqqadon nechshab keshello al yede ken kevan sheqqibbel alayv acharayuto, ella zeh niqra qabbalat hashshemira bilbad, sheqqibbel alayv sheyyishmor chametzo shel nokri, veim yipsha velo yishmerennu yapeh — chayyab leshallem lo, shehapposhea hu kemazziq bayyadayim, kevan sheqqibbel alayv lishmor kederek hashshomerim, vehammapqid samak alayv velo shemaro beatzmo]: vaapillu im hannokri hu allam veyikpehu leshallem lo ap im yigganeb o yobad mimmennu beones, mikkol maqom kevan shehayyisrael lo qibbel alayv acharayut haones vehu patur middin tora umiddin hammelek — en hechametz nechshab keshello, ad shemmitchayyeb beacharayuto bigzelat hannokri:

Vekol zeh kesheqqibbel mimmennu happiqqadon bistam, shello yiched lo maqom lehanniach bo happiqqadon, ella netalo hayyisrael miyyad hannokri vehinnicho beezeh zavit shebbebeto, ureshut beyado letaltelo ulepannoto mizzavit zo ulehannicho bezavit acheret, kevan shello hibtiach lehannokri leyached qeren zavit achat lachametzo. Veken im amar lehannokri: "hare kol beti lepaneka, hannach piqdoneka beezeh maqom shettirtzeh babbayit", dekevan shello yiched lo hayyisrael zavit meyuchedet lachametzo — hare hechametz masur beyad hayyisrael lepannoto miqqeren zavit zo ulehannicho bezavit acheret kemo chametz shello mammash, lepikak im qibbel alayv acharayuto — hare hu naasa keshello mammash veober alayv. Abal im beshaa shehipqid etzlo yiched lo zavit meyuchedet sheyyihyeh chametzo munnach sham ad sheyyabo hannokri littelo mishsham, vehinnicho hannokri beatzmo beotah zavit sheyyiched lo hayyisrael, o shehinnicho sham hayyisrael bemaamad hannokri, vehibtiach lo shezzavit zo tehe meyuchedet lachametzo ad sheyyabo hannokri veyittelenna mishsham, kevan sheen hechametz masur beyad hayyisrael letaltelo ulepannoto mizzavit zo lemaqom acher, shehare kebar masar otah zavit lehannokri — en tzarik lebaaro ap sheqqibbel alayv acharayut miggeneba vaabeda beones (raq sheyyizaharu laasot lepanayv mechitztza kehilkato, kemo shennitbaer), shenneemar "lo yimmatze", mi shemmatzuy beyadeka, yatza zeh sheeno matzuy beyadeka, shehare hu munnach bezavit hamyuchedet lannokri, vahare zeh domeh limqabbel alayv acharayut chametzo shel nokri hammunnach birshut hannokri sheeno ober alayv. Ap al pi shehechametz shel yisrael mammash hammunnach birshut nokri hare zeh ober alayv kemo shennitbaer lemala, mikkol maqom chametz zeh hu shel hannokri, ella sheacharayuto hu al hayyisrael, lepikak en lo din chametzo shel yisrael mammash, veeno ober alayv ella im ken hu masur beyado letaltelo ulepannoto lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh kemo chametz shello mammash:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehechametz hazzeh bishat habbiur, dehaynu shaa shishshit beereb pesach, hu munnach beotah zavit sheyyiched lo, ulekak en tzarik lebaaro. Veken bekol yeme happesach, kol zeman shehechametz hu munnach bazzavit sheyyiched lo eno ober alayv mittaam shennitbaer, abal im pinna hayyisrael et hechametz mizzavit zo sheyyiched lo lezavit acheret shebbabbayit o shebbekol maqom shebbirshuto, ukeshehiggia sheat habbiur hu munnach beoto zavit haacheret — chayyab lebaaro, o sheyyachazirennu miyyad limqomo. Vaapillu natal hayyisrael et hechametz hazzeh qodem shehiggia zeman habbiur veholiko lenokri acher vehipqido etzlo bebeto, ap al pi ken kesheyyaggia zeman habbiur chayyab lelek velittelo miyyad hannokri ulebaaro, o sheyyachazirennu leoto zavit sheyyiched lehannokri hammapqid. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehannokri hannipqad hashsheni lo qibbel alayv acharayut hechametz kederek sheqqibbel alayv hayyisrael, abal im kol haacharayut shehaya al hayyisrael qibbel alayv gam ken hannokri hannipqad hashsheni — en tzarik lebaaro. Ap al pi shechametz shehu shel yisrael mammash hammupqad etzel nokri ap sheqqibbel alayv hannokri acharayut en moil kelum liptor et hayyisrael shello yaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" kemo shennitbaer lemala, mikkol maqom chametz zeh shehu shel nokri ella sheacharayuto hu al hayyisrael veal yede ken naasa keillu haya shello, vekevan shennokri acher qibbel alayv acharayut shehaya al hayyisrael — en leyisrael cheleq venachala bechametz zeh, veen tzarik lebaaro kelal ap im hayyisrael lo yiched zavit meyuchedet lannokri hammapqid:

Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim dekol sheacharayut hechametz hu al hayyisrael, apillu lo qibbel alayv ella acharayut shel geneba vaabeda habbaim mechamat peshiuto shello shamar kederek hashshomerim, velo beacharayut shel geneba vaabeda habbaim beones, veken apillu im lo qibbel alayv acharayut kelal ben mechamat peshia ben mechamat ones ella lishmor bechinnam, venimtza shehannokri hu allam veyippara mimmennu im yigganeb veyobad mimmennu mechamat peshiuto bishmirato — hare chametz zeh hu keshello mammash, vechayyab lebaaro beereb pesach min hattora. Veken apillu im hiskir lannokri cheder meyuchad bebeto sheyyanniach sham chametzo, sheeno niptar mechiyyubo bishbil zeh, (ella) sheen hechametz masur beyad hayyisrael letaltelo ulepannoto lemaqom sheyyirtzeh:

Veken apillu im natal hayyisrael et happiqqadon veholiko lebet nokri acher vehipqido etzlo veqibbel alayv hannokri hashsheni kol haacharayut shehaya al hayyisrael — ap al pi ken chayyab lebaer, dekevan sheim yigganeb o yobad mehannokri hashsheni hare nokri hammapqid chozer al hayyisrael sheyyeshallem lo chametzo, veen lo kelum al hannokri hashsheni, shehare lo hipqid beyado meuma, lepikak nechshab chametz zeh lehayyisrael keillu haya shello mammash, shehu chayyab lebaaro ap im hu mupqad beyad nokri veqibbel alayv hannokri apillu acharayut shel geneba vaabeda beones, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal im hannokri hammapqid lo hipqid kelal et hechametz beyad hayyisrael ella hipqido beyad hannokri acher vehayyisrael qibbel alayv acharayut happiqqadon — eno ober alayv, apillu im hannokri hannipqad lo qibbel alayv shum acharayut, shehare neemar "bebattekem", vezeh hechametz eno bebeto ubirshuto shel hayyisrael, shehare nokri hannipqad lo hishil lehayyisrael et hammaqom shehechametz munnach alayv bebeto, ella lehannokri hammapqid etzlo hu shehishilo. Veap middibre soperim en tzarik lebaaro, dekevan sheggup hechametz eno shello, ella al yede sheacharayuto alayv hu naasa keshello, lepikak lo gazeru alayv chakamim beshello hipqido hu beatzmo beyad hannokri:

Veen tzarik lomar sheim achar shehipqid hannokri baal hechametz et chametzo beyad hayyisrael veqibbel alayv hayyisrael acharayut chazar hayyisrael veholiko lebet bealayv hannokri vehipqido etzlo, ap al pi shehitna immo hannokri sheyyihyeh alayv adayin acharayut happiqqadon kemo shehaya miqqodem, ap al pi ken eno ober alayv apillu middibre soperim, kevan sheeno bebeto velo birshuto shel hayyisrael:

Uleinyan halaka bekol arbaa debarim sheyyesh ben sebara harishona lassebara haacharona — yesh lehachamir lekattechilla kassebara haacharona, dehaynu sheyyachazir happiqqadon libalayv, o sheyyimkerennu lenokri acher qodem shettaggia shaa shishshit beereb pesach. Abal bediabad shekkebar higgia shaa shishshit shei epshar lemokro lenokri, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"g, vegam hannokri baal hechametz eno bair sheyyachazirennu lo — yesh lismok al sebara harishona bekol zeh, veen hayyisrael chayyab lebaaro min haolam legamre, ella muttar lo lehashhot chametz zeh ad sheyyabo bealayv hannokri lair. Apillu ba betok happesach — yachazir lo chametzo miyyad beboo (raq sheyyizzaher shello yigga bo beyadayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"d), kede latzet mechashash issur shel tora sheyyesh bishhiyya zo lepi sebara haacharona. Veachar happesach muttar chametz zeh apillu baakila, apillu lo hecheziro libalayv ad achar happesach:

Abal kol maqom shehu chayyab lebaaro ap lepi sebara harishona veshakach o neenas velo biaro, ap al pi sheggup hechametz hu shel hannokri, mikkol maqom kevan sheabar alayv yisrael be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" — hare hu asur baakila ubahanaa lekol adam miyyisrael, kedin chametzo shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach sheyyitbaer besiman tm"ch. Umikkol maqom, im ba hannokri baal hechametz littol chametzo, ben shebba betok happesach ben shebba leachar happesach — rashshay hayyisrael litteno lo veen zeh keporea chobo meissure hanaa, shehare lo nitchayyeb hayyisrael kelum lehannokri, kevan shechametzo hu beayin — hare omer lo "hare shelleka lepaneka". Veap al pi sheyyesh lachosh shemma yimkor hannokri et hechametz hazzeh leachar happesach leyisrael acher sheeno yodea sheabar alayv yisrael be"bal yeraeh", veal yede ken asur baakila ubahanaa, veyokal veyehaneh mimmennu, mikkol maqom mippene chashasha zo en lanu lakop et hayyisrael hannipqad sheyyebaer chametzo shel nokri vishallem lo damayv mikkiso. Velo aseru mippene zeh ella limkor lenokri chametzo mammash im hu beinyan sheepshar labo taqqala leyisrael acher sheyyiqqach chametzo min hannokri, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"z. Abal zeh eno moker lo kelum, ella sheeno qoneh mimmennu — en lanu lakop oto al kak, raq im yirtzeh meatzmo laasot hattob vehayyashar lebaer uleshallem lehannokri damayv kede shello tabo taqqala leyisrael acher al yado — tabo alayv beraka:
